0022600115.text: The Toronto Raptors (2-0, 1-0 on the road, second in the Atlantic at 0.5 games back and fourth in the East) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (2-0, 2-0 on the road, third in the Northwest and sixth in the West) for the Raptors' third game of the 2026-27 season, with both teams unbeaten so far. Toronto is missing Brandon Ingram (out, heel surgery) and Nate Bittle (out, foot fracture), while Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and their last meeting was a 115-107 Minnesota win in Minneapolis on March 5, 2026, part of a 2025-26 season series in which the Raptors lost 0-2.
